sentences.en: The television show was interrupted by a special news report.
sentences.zh: 电视节目被一则特别新闻中断了。

sentences.en: To teach Alex, Pepperberg used a special form of training.
sentences.zh: 为了教Alex，佩珀伯格使用了一种特殊的训练方法。

sentences.en: As my watch was slow, I missed the special express.
sentences.zh: 因为我手表慢了，错过了特快列车。
